title.narrative: Inclusive Private Sector Enabling Environment - CIPE Consortia
Inclusive Private Sector Enabling Environment - CIPE Consortia

description.narrative: CIPE and its consortia will pursue the following two objectives during the project: Objective 1: To empower marginalized groups and communities to participate effectively in and benefit from economic development and trade. Objective 2: To strengthen the ability of the private sector to engage in effective policy reform that leads to positive regulatory and policy changes conducive for the Ethiopian private sector at the national, regional, and sub-regional levels. Objective 3 To assist BMOs, business owners, and marginal economic actors in their responses to the COVID 19 health crisis Objective 4 To increase awareness and to foster collaboration among chambers of commerce and BMOs in contributing to economic recover

Det föreslagna initiativet syftar till en bottom-up modell och en lokal strategi till den privata sektorns utveckling för att möjliggöra ökandet av storleken på den privata sektorn, dess organisatoriska kapacitet och dess politiska samt ekonomiska roll. Vidare syftar den till att nyttja den nuvarande politiska viljan och ett befintligt engagemang för att möjliggöra utveckling av den privata sektorn för ökad tillväxt, samt för en starkare dialog mellan den privata- och offentliga sektorn.

The proposed initiative aims for a bottom-up and local approach to private sector development in order to increase the size of private sector, its organizational capacity, and its political and economic role. Further more, it aims to seize the current opportunity of political will and commitment for opening up of the environment for private sector development and inclusive growth for a stronger private public dialogues.

There are a list of results that have been achieved with this contribution as highlighted in the terminal report and end line evaluation. However, the major higher level achievements of this program are; (i) empowerment of women through the revolving fund facility opportunity which is manifested in terms of economic and leadership capacities. This particular impact has direct contribution to Sida's strategic result areas, i.e. 'inclusive economic development' and met the overarching perspectives of 'the poor peoples perspective'. (ii) improvement of service provisions by business membership organizations (BMOs) for their respective members. Although the BMO space is still nascent, the project has made concentrated efforts to improve the technical and financial capacity in their provision of services. Notable impact is also the integration of peace development/conflict mitigation as businesses role which bear fruit in starting business to business linkages/dialogues at local level especially in conflict affected regions. (iii) creating momentum in terms of BMO's capacity for representation, advocacy and production of researches for their members at the highest level of policy platforms. Notable impact is the platforms the projects has supported leading to higher level policy discussions and changes complementing advocacy capacity of the private sector. Even though the practice of public-private-dialogue and advocacy activities are still at early stage, the achievements are assessed to be promising for further interventions.
